candidates.description: This vector activates on common Italian grammatical words and pronouns.
This vector represents coastal environments, marine bodies of water, and associated seaside or aquatic geography.
This vector represents terms related to skateboarding and boards, blended with noisy subword fragments.
This vector represents common adjectives used to describe physical or qualitative attributes.
This vector represents items related to outdoor recreation, water sports, and camping gear.
This vector activates for tokens containing the letter sequence "sp" or variations of the Italian root for day ("giorn", related to "sp" errors).
These tokens represent dynamic action verbs frequently used to state logical operations, propositions, or core arguments.
This feature activates on words, roots, and subword tokens containing the character sequence "ult".
This feature vector represents common morphological endings, stems, and frequently occurring character sequences found in Romance and Germanic languages.
The tokens represent the letter sequence "ab" and "ib" with various preceding prefixes and capitalization variants.
